property.title: Single zero-based pass over all coefficients

possible_encodings.reason: The target call and selected claim can be represented by explicit harness assumptions, snapshots, and assertions.
The semantic record explicitly requires loop reasoning; a loop-only contract does not satisfy a separate modular-call requirement.
A function contract is an optional alternative; the semantic record does not require modular replacement.
Hybrid encoding is optional when both a complete harness claim and contract artefact are available.

semantic_property.statement: The call performs exactly MLKEM_N iterations starting at 0 and visiting each coefficient position once.
semantic_property.success_predicate: ∀i∈{0,…,MLKEM_N-1}: the call reaches i exactly once and the only per-iteration write targets r->coeffs[i]

evidence_references.supports_claim: The loop structure is a single zero-based pass.

evidence_references.excerpt: All arrays have indices that begin at zero.
evidence_references.supports_claim: The relevant coefficient indexing convention is zero-based.

semantic_property.uncertainty: No formal loop contract is visible in the snapshot.

semantic_completeness.claim_boundary: Completeness means the semantic claim is structurally specified; it is not proof or frontend readiness.

property.candidate_statement: The function uses one for-loop initialized at i = 0 and bounded by i < MLKEM_N; with MLKEM_N = 256 this traverses the 256 coefficient positions in order.

supporting_evidence.supports_claim: The loop starts at zero and uses MLKEM_N as its upper bound.

supporting_evidence.excerpt: All arrays have indices that begin at zero. An element f of R_q is represented by the array (f0, f1, ..., f255) in Z_q^256.
supporting_evidence.supports_claim: The specification uses zero-based 256-entry coefficient arrays.

property.expected_artifact_type: strategy-neutral semantic property; Agent 5 must select an explicit encoding
out_of_scope_boundaries: Does not assert the computed values themselves.
Does not assert modulo-q normalization or canonical output.
Does not claim anything about aliasing or external wrappers.
property.uncertainty: The snapshot does not include loop contracts, so this is a local structural property only.
limitations: This is a coverage/access-pattern candidate, not a full functional specification.
It does not establish the abstract ring meaning of the update.

content.selection_reason: Selected after the LLM-authored candidate set was saved and post-classified. Selection is an experiment-control decision, not proof that the property is true.

effective_property_campaign.claim_boundary: Local selected claim only; uncatalogued status does not imply truth, novelty, or provability.
